tips.text: Walk through minions with Nimble Fighter and hit the enemy to start Seastone Trident's bleed, then follow up with the empowered attack a moment later.
Use Seastone Trident on a low-health enemy or minion; a kill refunds its mana and cuts its cooldown.
Dash onto a target with Urchin Strike, and cast Seastone Trident during the dash so your first attack lands hard.
Save Playful / Trickster to dodge a key enemy spell, because Fizz cannot be targeted while balanced on his trident.
Use Playful / Trickster to slow enemies when you land, then trade or chase while they are slowed.
Throw Chum the Waters from far away at an enemy for a bigger shark. It can also be aimed at where they are heading.
Do not use Urchin Strike on an enemy who is untargetable, because it deals no damage to them.

combos.name: Q into E dodge
combos.when: When you dash onto a target and want to dodge their burst or crowd control.
combos.text: Fizz can't cast Playful for a short moment after Urchin Strike, so wait a beat before pressing it. The untargetable hop then dodges their reaction.

combos.name: Double hop with Trickster
combos.when: When you need to dodge a spell, then close the gap or escape.
combos.text: Recast Playful while balanced on the trident to dash again. You can aim each dash separately, which makes your landing hard to predict.

combos.name: Chum the Waters long throw
combos.when: When you want the biggest shark from your ultimate.
combos.text: Aim the ultimate at long range so the lure flies far before it lands or attaches. A longer throw gives a bigger shark, more damage and a stronger slow.

tips.text: Walk through minions to stay out of Charm's line. It stops at the first enemy it hits, so minions in front of you absorb it.
Save Playful to dodge Charm. Being untargetable lets you avoid her whole combo, so don't spend it early.
Go in with Urchin Strike once Charm is on cooldown. Ahri has little to stop you then, so trade hard.
Aim Chum the Waters at where Ahri is heading. Without Spirit Rush she can hardly escape the shark.
Hit Ahri with Seastone Trident and keep fighting while it is active. The bonus damage lasts a few seconds.
Wait until Akali spends her energy on Five Point Strike, then dive in with Urchin Strike while she cannot answer.
Use Playful / Trickster as Akali jumps in with Perfect Execution; you cannot be targeted while balanced on the trident.
Throw Chum the Waters at her smoke edge or where she will run; the shark's area still hits her inside Twilight Shroud.
Walk through minions to apply Seastone Trident's bleed, then hit Akali with the empowered attack when she steps in.
Use Playful to dodge Akshan's Avengerang or his stored Comeuppance shots; Fizz can't be targeted while balanced on the trident.
Walk through minions with Nimble Fighter to reach Akshan, and start the trade with Seastone Trident.
Go in with Urchin Strike, then use Playful so Akshan is slowed and can't easily get away.
Aim Chum the Waters at Akshan from long range when he swings away; a long throw slows him more and hits harder.
Dodge Flash Frost by sidestepping or by using Playful just as it reaches you. Getting stunned by it often means you die.
Use Urchin Strike on Anivia as soon as her Flash Frost is spent, then stick to her and fight.
Her Crystallize wall is blocking terrain that you can't cross, so go around it or hit her before she places it.
Don't stay in Glacial Storm. Use Playful to get out of it or to close on her.
Kill her egg: after Rebirth she is helpless for a few seconds, so keep hitting it. Chum the Waters can help finish her.
Stay out of Annie's range when her Pyromania stun is ready. A stun leaves you stuck while she bursts you down.
Save Playful / Trickster for dodging Annie's stun. While you are untargetable, her targeted spells can't hit you.
Dash in with Urchin Strike once Annie has spent her stun. Then trade with Seastone Trident while her spells are on cooldown.
Throw Chum the Waters at long range when Annie is out of position. Her Tibbers is far less dangerous if you are not next to it.
Dodge Falling Star by hopping with Playful when you see the star marker; you are untargetable while balanced on the trident.
Walk through minions to get close, since Nimble Fighter lets you pass through units, then jump on him with Urchin Strike.
Go in once Singularity is on cooldown; avoid fighting in the black hole, where you get dragged toward the center.
Trade with Seastone Trident when he channels Breath of Light; the beam must stay aimed, so close in and hit him.
Land Chum the Waters from long range on him when he flies off with Astral Flight; he gets slowed and cannot easily escape.
Save Playful for when Aurora uses The Weirding or Twofold Hex; you are untargetable for a moment, so her aimed spells miss.
Aurora turns invisible after Across the Veil. Do not chase blindly; wait for her to attack, since that breaks the invisibility.
Stay out of her Between Worlds ring if you can. Enemies who touch its edge are slowed, and she can jump across it.
Trade with Urchin Strike, then hit with Seastone Trident, and slip away with Playful once her short cooldowns are spent.
Use Playful to dodge Azir's big spells; you can't be targeted while balanced on the trident. Save it for when he commits.
Dash onto Azir with Urchin Strike when his Sand Soldiers are far away or used up, then trade fast.
Chum the Waters is a strong all-in at level 6. Throw it from long range for a bigger shark and a stronger slow.
Don't throw Chum the Waters into Azir's wall of soldiers; the lure won't pass through it.
Walk through minions and Sand Soldiers freely. Use Nimble Fighter to close in without being blocked.
Dodge Sear by hopping with Playful or sidestepping; without his first ability landing, Brand can't start his combo.
Use Playful to avoid Pillar of Flame, since you are untargetable while balanced on the trident.
Close in with Urchin Strike once Brand has spent his abilities, then stay on him; he is weak up close.
Throw Chum the Waters from far away at Brand; a longer throw gives a bigger shark and a stronger slow.
Hop away with Playful just before Briar's Head Rush lands; Fizz is untargetable while balanced, so the stun misses.
Briar loses control while in Blood Frenzy and must chase the nearest enemy. Kite her with Playful, then slow her when she runs at you.
Aim Chum the Waters at Briar from long range for the biggest shark, and she is slowed before it hits.
Trade with Seastone Trident when Briar is low. Her bleed heals her, so short, sharp trades beat long brawls.
Don't stand in the open when Briar's Chilling Scream is charging. Fully charged, it throws you into a wall and stuns, so fight away from walls.
Stay out of Noxious Blast and Miasma. Miasma grounds you, which stops Playful / Trickster from getting you out.
Use Playful / Trickster to dodge Cassiopeia's big spells. You can't be targeted while balanced on the trident.
Don't face Cassiopeia when she casts Petrifying Gaze. Turn away and you are slowed, not stunned.
Dash in with Urchin Strike, then hit with Seastone Trident, and trade fast. Cassiopeia is fragile up close.
Aim Chum the Waters from long range at Cassiopeia. A longer throw makes a bigger shark that slows her more.
Hop away with Playful when Diana commits Lunar Rush or Moonfall; you can't be targeted while balanced on the trident.
Hold Playful until Diana dashes in. Her Lunar Rush is blocked if she tries to reach you while you are untargetable, so she wastes her engage.
Walk through minions to dodge Crescent Strike. Moving in a different direction from the arc's path makes it easier to miss.
Don't trade into Pale Cascade while the orbs are out; they hurt and shield her. Wait for them to fade, then use Urchin Strike.
Aim Chum the Waters at Diana from far away if you can, since a longer throw makes a bigger shark that slows more.
Use Seastone Trident on her after Urchin Strike; it keeps hurting her while she tries to fight back.
Use Playful to dodge Ekko's Timewinder or the stun zone; you are untargetable while balanced on the trident.
Watch for Ekko's Chronobreak trail. When it is down, he is much easier to trade with and kill.
Walk through minions to put Seastone Trident's bleed on Ekko, then hit him with the empowered attack.
Do not stand in Ekko's Parallel Convergence circle; you get stunned if he steps into it.
Save Chum the Waters for when Ekko has used Chronobreak, so he cannot rewind out of the damage.
Walk through minions to get close to Ezreal. Minions block his Mystic Shot, so use them as cover.
Jump in with Urchin Strike when Arcane Shift is on cooldown. Ezreal has no easy way to escape you then.
Use Playful to dodge Ezreal's skill shots. You can't be targeted while you are balanced on the trident.
Ezreal is fragile, so hit him with Seastone Trident and then Urchin Strike. Fight him when his spells are down.
Don't dive onto Galio while his Shield of Durand is charging. His taunt pulls you in and he takes less damage.
Use Playful / Trickster to dodge Justice Punch, since you can't be targeted while balanced. Land on him after it misses.
Walk through your minions to dodge Winds of War. Its tornado hurts more the more health you have.
Aim Chum the Waters at Galio from long range for a bigger shark. Galio can't easily escape the slow.
Watch for Hero's Entrance across the map and be ready to fight or avoid a gank.
Rush Hwei right after he casts a Torment spell; he is open to being run down once it is out.
Use Playful to dodge his slow lightning and his Crushing Maw, since you can't be targeted while balanced on the trident.
Walk through minions with Nimble Fighter and hit Hwei with Seastone Trident, so he can't line up his spells in a straight line.
Save Chum the Waters for when Hwei is rooted or feared; he can't dodge it, and a long throw makes it hit harder.
Hop away with Playful when Irelia dashes at you; you can't be targeted, so her Bladesurge is wasted.
Watch for Irelia stacking Ionian Fervor on minions; engage her when the stacks are gone.
Don't spend Chum the Waters or Urchin Strike into Defiant Dance; she takes less damage while she charges.
Stay out of Flawless Duet's line between her blades; being stunned in range of her Bladesurge is deadly.
Do not walk up to Kassadin with Urchin Strike when Null Sphere is ready; his shield cuts your damage and he can hit back.
Trade early, before Kassadin reaches level 6. He is weak then and Riftwalk is hard for him to use.
Play Playful to dodge Force Pulse's slow, and pick your moment when it is on cooldown.
Aim Chum the Waters at where Kassadin will land. Riftwalk makes him hard to catch and he is slowed if the lure hits him.
Use Playful to dodge Katarina's Death Lotus or Bouncing Blade, then land on her. Only the area hit by the Death Lotus matters.
Hold Playful for when Katarina uses Shunpo on you, so she cannot easily chase you.
Aim Chum the Waters at Katarina after she uses Shunpo; the shark's knockup interrupts her Death Lotus.
Trade with Urchin Strike and Seastone Trident when her Bouncing Blade is on cooldown. Stay close and move through minions to avoid her Daggers.
Stay out of LeBlanc's range. When Sigil of Malice lands on you, avoid her follow-up spells, which detonate it.
Use Playful to dodge Ethereal Chains. You are untargetable while on your trident, so the chain can't hit you.
Hit LeBlanc with Urchin Strike when she dashes in with Distortion, before she can recast back to safety.
Hit LeBlanc with Playful when she is out of Distortion. Its slow makes it hard for her to escape.
Chum the Waters is best at long range against LeBlanc, which makes her slowed and knocked up.
Save Playful for when Lissandra uses Frozen Tomb on you or Ring of Frost; being untargetable lets you dodge the ability's hit.
Walk through minions to stay out of the way of Ice Shard; it slows only the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion between you.
Go in right after Ring of Frost is used, while it is on its long cooldown. Then trade with Urchin Strike and Seastone Trident.
Aim Chum the Waters from long range at Lissandra when she is not near a wall; she cannot easily escape it without her ultimate.
Do not fight in her Frozen Tomb ice field; it slows you and leaves you easy to catch.
Dodge Light Binding by using Playful / Trickster, which makes you untargetable, or by staying out of line with Lux's minions.
Wait until Lux has used Light Binding, then go in with Urchin Strike and kill her before it comes back.
Lucent Singularity slows you, so avoid standing in it. Leave the area or hop out with Playful / Trickster.
Throw Chum the Waters from far away at Lux; a longer throw makes a bigger shark that slows her more and hurts more.
Lux's shield from Prismatic Barrier is small, so use Seastone Trident to hit her hard once it runs out.
Hit Malzahar with Urchin Strike only after his Void Shift has been used up, or the damage is mostly wasted.
Do not throw Chum the Waters at Malzahar while Void Shift is active; it will not stick.
Stay out of Call of the Void's portals, or save Playful to dodge it. Being silenced leaves you without Trickster.
Keep Playful ready when Malzahar goes for Nether Grasp. Being untargetable stops him from locking you down.
Stay away from minions carrying Malefic Visions. They pass it to you when they die.
Mel's Rebuttal destroys projectiles, including the lure from Chum the Waters. Wait until she has used it, then throw your ultimate.
Hop with Playful when Solar Snare is coming. Fizz can't be targeted while balanced on his trident, so the orb misses.
Wait for Mel to spend Solar Snare before you dive in. If it hits, you are rooted and easy to kill.
Back off when you are low, because Mel's Overwhelm can execute you. Her stacks fade after a few seconds without hits.
Trade with Urchin Strike and a Seastone Trident hit, then leave with Playful. Mel's long-range poke is weaker if you don't stay in range.
Press Playful when Naafiri locks onto you with Hounds' Pursuit; you are untargetable and her dash lands on nothing.
Walk through her Packmates with Nimble Fighter to reach Naafiri instead of hitting them.
Land Chum the Waters from far away when she is out of position; a longer throw makes a bigger shark and a stronger slow.
Trade with Urchin Strike and Seastone Trident together when her Darkin Daggers are on cooldown.
Walk through minions to stay out of Command: Attack, and keep Playful ready to dodge it. Orianna can only hit where her Ball is.
Do not hop in with Playful when Command: Shockwave is ready. Landing near her Ball gets you pulled in and stunned.
Wait until Orianna has used her Ball's spells, then go in with Urchin Strike. She has little left to stop you.
Aim Chum the Waters at Orianna from far away, or where she will go. A longer throw makes a bigger, stronger shark.
Use Seastone Trident's empowered attack just after Urchin Strike so she takes the burst before she can react.
Use Playful to become untargetable when Qiyana dashes in with Audacity; her damage can miss you while you hop.
Save Playful for when she commits a big ability, then land and slow her to start your own trade.
Aim Chum the Waters at her when she is near a wall or river; it is slow and hard to dodge once the fish sticks.
Walk through minions with Nimble Fighter and hit her with Seastone Trident so the bleed ticks before she can trade back.
Respect her Supreme Display of Talent near walls; the stun can lock you in place, so keep Playful ready.
Don't walk into Ryze's range at low health. Spell Flux then Rune Prison roots you, so keep Playful ready to escape.
Use Playful to dodge Ryze's key spells. You can't be targeted on the trident, so bait Rune Prison and punish him after.
Dive onto Ryze with Urchin Strike, then use Seastone Trident on your next attack. Ryze has few ways to stop a close-range fight.
Aim Chum the Waters at Ryze from far away for the biggest shark. Ryze can be hard to catch, so throw it when he is committed to a spell.
Stay out of Ryze's Overload line when your minions are near. He gets strong once Flux is on you, so avoid being hit by Spell Flux.
Save Playful for when Sylas commits Abduct; being untargetable lets you dodge the pull and punish him after.
Trade with Urchin Strike and Seastone Trident when Kingslayer is on cooldown, so Sylas cannot lunge in and heal off you.
Walk through minions to dodge Chain Lash, since you can move through units.
At level 6, aim Chum the Waters at Sylas from far away for a stronger hit and bigger slow, then fight while he is slowed.
Dodge Syndra's Scatter the Weak with Playful; you are untargetable while balanced, then punish her with Urchin Strike while it recharges.
Stay out of the Dark Spheres on the ground; a Scatter the Weak push into them leaves you stunned.
Walk through minions with Nimble Fighter and hit Syndra with Seastone Trident to make her bleed, then follow with the empowered attack.
Look for an all-in once Syndra has used Scatter the Weak; she has few ways to stop you while it recharges.
Save Chum the Waters for when Syndra has used her escapes, and aim it at where she will step, not just where she stands.
Stay out of Taliyah's Unraveled Earth stones. Dashing through them with Urchin Strike or Playful sets them off and stuns you.
Taliyah's Seismic Shove can throw you into her stones. Walk out of the marked area as soon as you see it start.
Threaded Volley flies in a straight line. Step to the side, or hop away with Playful, to dodge it.
Hit Taliyah with Urchin Strike when her Unraveled Earth is on cooldown. Then use Seastone Trident and fight, since she has little to stop you.
Aim Chum the Waters from far away at Taliyah so it hits hard. She cannot easily dodge it once the fish attaches.
Use Playful when Talon jumps in with Noxian Diplomacy; it makes you untargetable so his burst misses.
Step out of the way of Rake's blades. They come back and slow you, so avoid standing at its maximum range.
Hit Talon with Seastone Trident and Urchin Strike when he lands, then back off before his stacks of Blade's End build up.
When Talon's Shadow Assault is on cooldown, he is much easier to catch. Fight him then with Chum the Waters.
Watch for Talon roaming through walls with Assassin's Path, and push your lane first so you can follow him.
Walk through minions with Nimble Fighter to dodge the cards of Wild Cards, since each card only hits once.
Use Playful to dodge Twisted Fate's Gold Card attack, then land on him for damage and a slow.
Twisted Fate can use Destiny to teleport away, so keep Urchin Strike ready to chase him down.
Aim Chum the Waters at where Twisted Fate will be channeling Destiny; it can hit him while he stands still.
Stay out of the edge of Event Horizon. Inside the cage you can still move, so wait for it to fade or walk around it.
Dive Veigar with Urchin Strike when Event Horizon is on cooldown. He is fragile and has little to stop you.
Use Playful when Dark Matter lands, since you can't be targeted. Walk out of the circle as it falls.
Don't linger at low health in range of Veigar. Primordial Burst hits harder the lower you are.
Hold Playful until Vex has used her empowered ability; her fear can't catch you while you are untargetable.
Look for the icon change on Vex's abilities showing her fear is ready, and stay out of her range until she spends it.
Dashing near Vex marks you with Gloom, so her next hit deals bonus damage. Use Urchin Strike only when you will trade, not just to move around.
Use Chum the Waters from long range when you can; the farther the fish flies, the bigger the shark and the stronger the slow.
Walk through minions to apply Seastone Trident, then hit her with the empowered attack once you are close.
Dodge Viktor's Gravity Field by using Playful, because Fizz can't be targeted while balanced on the trident. Don't just walk into the field.
Hold Playful for when Viktor casts Hextech Ray at you. Fizz is untargetable on the trident, so the ray misses.
Go in with Urchin Strike once Viktor has used Gravity Field or Hextech Ray, then trade with Seastone Trident while he waits on cooldowns.
Chum the Waters can be thrown at Viktor from long range. Do it when he stands still, and he is slowed until the shark lands.
Step out of Arcane Storm early. It follows you, so use Playful to get clear of it instead of fighting inside it.
Bait Sanguine Pool early, then go in. Vladimir can't be targeted while pooled, and it costs him health.
Don't linger in Vladimir's Sanguine Pool. You are slowed and take damage inside it.
Land Chum the Waters from long range so the shark hits harder. Aim it at Vladimir's path or at the champion himself.
Kill Vladimir before Hemoplague bursts, because it heals him for each champion hit. Use Playful to get out of the area.
Tides of Blood bolts are blocked by minions. Stand behind them when Vladimir charges it.
Save Playful / Trickster to dodge Shocking Orb. You can't be targeted while balanced, so use it as Xerath casts.
Close the distance with Urchin Strike once Shocking Orb is on cooldown. Xerath is weak up close.
Walk sideways while Xerath charges Arcanopulse; it is harder to hit you that way.
When Xerath channels Rite of the Arcane, dodge the circles as they land. Each shot lands after a short delay.
Stay away while Xin Zhao has Three Talon Strike ready. Its third hit knocks you up, so use Playful to dodge it.
Xin Zhao's Audacious Charge cannot hit you while you hop on your trident with Playful, so use it when he charges in.
Use Urchin Strike to dash through Xin Zhao, then hit him with Seastone Trident while he is waiting for his cooldowns.
Don't walk next to Xin Zhao at level 6 if you are low. Crescent Guard's knockback stuns you and deals extra damage based on your current health.
Aim Chum the Waters from long range at Xin Zhao for the biggest shark. He can't escape easily if he is slowed.
Walk through minions with Nimble Fighter and hit Yasuo to apply the bleed from Seastone Trident, then follow with the empowered attack.
Use Playful when Yasuo's Steel Tempest whirlwind is coming. You are untargetable for a moment, so it misses you.
Do not rely on Chum the Waters flying through Wind Wall. It blocks the lure early, so cast it after the wall is gone or from another angle.
Avoid being knocked up when Yasuo has a chance to follow with Last Breath. Playful makes you untargetable, so it can dodge the whirlwind.
Dash onto Yasuo with Urchin Strike when his Sweeping Blade is down on you and his minions are away; he has fewer ways to escape.
Use Playful to dodge Yone's Fate Sealed; Fizz can't be targeted while balanced on the trident, so time it as the cast finishes.
Keep Chum the Waters for when Yone is stuck in a fight; it knocks him up and slows him, and a long throw hits hardest.
Walk through minions with Nimble Fighter and hit Yone with Seastone Trident to make him bleed, then follow up with the empowered attack.
Don't fight Yone while his Soul Unbound is ready; he can trade freely and then snap back to safety with extra damage.
Save Playful for when Zed uses Death Mark on you; being untargetable can make you dodge the dash's follow-up and the shadow swap.
Zed's shurikens are thrown in a line. Walk through minions with Nimble Fighter to dodge them and stay close to him.
Trade with Urchin Strike and Seastone Trident right after Zed spends his Living Shadow. He has less slow and less mobility then.
Aim Chum the Waters at Zed from long range for the biggest shark; if it attaches, he is slowed before it erupts.
Walk up and hit Zoe with Urchin Strike once Sleepy Trouble Bubble is on cooldown; she has little to stop you.
Dodge the bubble with Playful; Fizz can't be targeted while balanced on his trident, so it passes harmlessly.
Stay out of a straight line with Zoe when Sleepy Trouble Bubble is ready, because falling asleep means a lot of extra damage.
When Zoe uses Portal Jump she can't move for a moment. Dive her with Urchin Strike then.
Aim Chum the Waters from far away at Zoe; she is fragile and the knock up and slow make it hard for her to escape.
